landscape.title: Into the wild
landscape.subtitle: Film · Nature
landscape.prompt: A cinematic mountain landscape: mist over distant peaks, a winding river through a deep green forest, and golden morning sunlight on the summit. Natural film colors, a calm and expansive composition, delicate light and shadow, landscape orientation.

product.title: Everyday beauty
product.subtitle: Still life · Light
product.prompt: A handmade moss-green ceramic vase holding a eucalyptus branch, placed on an ivory stone plinth. Afternoon sunlight from the left casts a soft shadow. Premium product photography, natural materials, a minimal composition, warm and quiet.

architecture.title: Shapes of light
architecture.subtitle: Architecture · Minimal
architecture.prompt: A minimal Mediterranean building with cream limewashed walls and a sequence of archways. Warm sunlight through the arcade casts geometric shadows on the ground. Sandstone texture, terracotta tones, architectural editorial photography, clean composition, no people.

historyWarning.title: History is tied to your API key
historyWarning.keyNotice: History, the image gallery, and prompt templates all follow the current API key. After you switch API keys, records created under the old key can no longer be displayed — that is equivalent to losing them.
historyWarning.saveNotice: Please save your important generated images from the studio in good time and download them for safekeeping. If history is lost, we cannot guarantee it can be recovered.
historyWarning.dismissHint: You can still review this notice at any time in the API Key sign-in dialog. It also reappears when you sign in or switch the API key.
